C0400.title: Beijing Police Dismantle a Criminal Gang Providing 'Account Farming' and Other Underground Cyber Services
C0400.summary: A Ministry of Public Security case roundup for Operation Duanhao said Beijing cyber police uncovered a company suspected of aiding cybercrime. The company developed a cloud-control platform for managing online accounts and continued to provide account-farming services while knowing customers used the accounts for gambling, fraud, and other crimes. The case involved more than 5.5 million yuan, including over 3.6 million yuan in illegal gains.
